EXHIBIT NO. 5
DESCRIPTION OF PROJECT AND SUPPORTING FACILITY IMPROVEMENTS
1. Street Improvements:
The proposed street improvements, including cross sections thereof, are shown on Figure 1, Exhibit 7, Street and Site Improvements Map dated March 1962. Modifications to the existing street system have been limited to meet basic Plan objectives of land use, vehicular access to and from the neighborhood and circulation within the neighborhood. Alley modifications have been limited to those improvements which will permit the alley to function as originally intended. Street improvements consist of:
Reconstruction and extension of Harrison Street south to Colorado Avenue. This would utilize a 70' right-of-way with 48' of pavement to Lakeview Avenue, south from Lakeview Avenue to Colorado Avenue with a 50' right-of-way with 32' of paving would be utilized.
b. Realignment of Parkwood Avenue between Randolph Street and Allen Avenue.
c. Extension of Grayland Avenue between Davis Avenue and Shields Avenue, Lady Street and Allen Avenue and Harrison Street and Idlewood Avenue.
d. Relocation of Lakeview Avenue from Randolph Street to Harrison Street.
e. Construction of not less than five bridges by the Richmond Metropolitan Expressway Authority over the expressway.
f. Construction and/or reconstruction and paving of alleys as required to enable the alley system to function.
g. Widening of Allen Avenue from Powhatan Street to Winder Street to a 60' right-of-way with 40' of pavement.
h. Reconstruction of Dobson Street to provide for a reduction in pavement width to 16' and the inclusion of the deleted roadway as part of the pedestrian walkway system along the east side of the street to the Clarke Springs Elementary School.
   Resurfacing of the remaining streets which serve the neighborhood and which need surface treatment.
2. Sanitary Sewer:
Figure 2, Exhibit 7 schematically illustrates the proposed sanitary sewer system for the project area.
